rv.q: More than any interpretation I've seen of the 1944 drama that made Williams's name, this 'Menagerie' finds the brute force in a play often described, a bit condescendingly, as lyrical, wispy, elegiac.
It is, like the work itself, unforgettable.
No matter how archetypal these characters and familiar their experiences, when played with such subtlety and emotional veracity, they yield lingering rewards in the sad music of memory.
In whisks Cherry Jones’s Amanda, and the spell is cast.
Fine cast, led by Cherry Jones and Zachary Quinto, lends affecting life to this visually distinctive revival.
This is a fine evening at the theater, not a divine revelation.
Jones, one of the greatest stage actresses alive, conveys this in a performance that will amaze even her most ardent admirers in its depth and compassion.
Get to this brilliant, brilliant production.
Cherry Jones also defies expectations, playing Amanda not as a badgering witch but as a cauldron of disappointment overwhelmed with love and fear for her children's futures.
It’s a remarkably satisfying trip to a disturbing destination.
It seems fitting that this performance, and this production, will really exist only in memory – but there it will lodge.
But just as he did with Once, director John Tiffany has stripped Tennessee Williams’s 1944 career-maker of any extraneous elements and delivered it to us, fresh, alive, and powerful.

cn.t: John Tiffany's stunning revival breathes fresh life into Williams' classic, anchored by Cherry Jones' career-best performance as Amanda. Critics praise the production's delicate strength, visual distinction, and excellent ensemble work.

vs.sum: The Booth Theatre offers good sightlines with a well-raked mezzanine and clear views from most seats, though legroom can be tight. The theater's elegant, European-inspired design adds to its charm, while sound quality is consistently praised. Facilities are average, with typical restroom and concession offerings.

acc.note: 6 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Not completely wheelchair accessible. Infrared devices available.
